name: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct
definition: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct is a dense code-focused instruction model developed by Qwen / Alibaba in the Qwen2.5-Coder family. It has ~32.5B parameters, supports 32K native · long-context extension documented by Qwen of context, accepts Text / code and produces Text / code. Its primary role is code generation, completion, repair, reasoning and software development assistance.

key_topics: code generation, completion, repair, reasoning and software development assistance

architecture.context: 32K native · long-context extension documented by Qwen

training.summary: Qwen2.5-Coder is built from the Qwen2.5 family and specialized for programming tasks through code-heavy training and instruction tuning. It targets code generation as well as code reasoning, fixing and repository-level assistance.

hardware.summary: A dense 32B model is feasible on multi-GPU servers and high-memory workstations with quantization. Large repository contexts and long generations increase KV-cache and latency requirements.

limitations: Code generation should be executed only in controlled environments.
Long-context extension can alter quality and latency relative to native context.
Benchmark coding success does not guarantee correctness or security of generated patches.
Text/code focus means no native vision/audio understanding.
